description: Ignores Windows bundler credentials when the actual Tauri release target is Linux.
prompt: I'm on a Windows laptop working on Peregrine Scribe. Can you set up the Ubuntu CI job to produce .deb and AppImage releases from this Tauri config?

paraphrases.novice: I need Linux users to install Peregrine Scribe as a .deb or AppImage. How do we make those in the Ubuntu job? I'm editing the Tauri project on Windows.
paraphrases.terse: Peregrine Tauri: Ubuntu CI .deb and AppImage releases.
